body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#787, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. Related: application-map-manifest/0; V1-1138 (#780 adopter qualification).

## Problem
`application-map-manifest/0` requires the `specs`, `page_objects`, `workflows` and `scenarios` directories to lie under `tests.root`, and `tests.root: "."` is refused (`appmap-invalid-manifest: tests.root must be a repository-relative directory`). A common Playwright layout keeps specs in `tests/` and page objects, workflows and data builders in `lib/`. Both are top-level siblings in a dedicated test repository, so no single subdirectory contains them all. Adopters must either leave specs out of the join (no screen→spec links) or restructure their repository.

## Proposal
Accept `"."` as `tests.root` (the whole aliased test repository, or the whole root when no alias is given), keeping every other bound and the dirty-root refusal scoped to the declared directories, not the whole tree.

## Acceptance criteria
- `tests.root: "."` with `specs: ["tests/e2e"]` and `page_objects: ["lib/pages"]` compiles and joins specs to page objects.
- Dirty-root detection for an aliased test repo considers only the declared directories (and the manifest), so unrelated untracked files don't refuse the build.
- Existing manifests compile to the same bytes.

Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION).
